bio.text: Aaron Bean represents Florida's 4th Congressional District, which covers Clay, Duval and Nassau Counties, and serves on the House Committee on Ways and Means.
He was born and raised in Northeast Florida and was a community bank president before entering Congress.

He began in office as a City Commissioner and later Mayor of Fernandina Beach, was elected to the Florida House of Representatives in 2000 and to the Florida Senate in 2012, where he was Senate President Pro Tempore.
